dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: Fair enough, I guess Mamere has become a bit more open lately... But now, Ahes is going down that path...

dialogues.speaker: Serene
dialogues.text: If you don't mind, could you head over to the <color=#00E1FFFF>place with a lot of ships</color> north of the village, and see if you can help?
